selection_rules.duel: First paired seed/side where both full-brake and dynamic have a clean response to the same enemy attack ID; sorted by seed/side. This is a selected demonstration, not a random sample.
selection_rules.actions: First validation base seed, un-swapped side, both action families, regardless of response.
selection_rules.team_course: First course run with at least two contact-qualified interventions; explicitly a pressure course.
selection_rules.team_free: First free-team validation seed, un-swapped side, regardless of outcome.

limitations: Selection is for readability, not a random sample or independent performance validation.
Pressure relief or saved-win causality is not established.
